reference: She has been sprinting at full speed since the gun went off.
sk: Naplno šprintuje od chvíle, keď vyštartovala.
cz: Naplno sprintuje od chvíle, kdy vystartovala.
acceptable: She has been sprinting {at full speed|flat out|all out} since {the gun went off|she started|she took off|the start|the moment she started|the moment she took off}.
Since {the gun went off|she started|she took off|the start}, she has been sprinting {at full speed|flat out|all out}.

mistakes.text: She sprints at full speed since {the gun went off|she started|she took off}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadruje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been sprinting“, nie „sprints“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadřuje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been sprinting“, ne „sprints“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action that started in the past and is still going on needs Present Perfect Continuous: “has been sprinting”, not “sprints”.

mistakes.text: She is sprinting at full speed since {the gun went off|she started|she took off}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadruje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been sprinting“, nie „is sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadřuje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been sprinting“, ne „is sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action that started in the past and is still going on needs Present Perfect Continuous: “has been sprinting”, not “is sprinting”.

mistakes.text: She has been sprinting at full speed since {the gun has gone off|she has started|she has taken off}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „since“ je jednorazový dej v minulosti, preto Past Simple: „since she started“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „since“ je jednorázový děj v minulosti, proto Past Simple: „since she started“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “since”, the starting event is a finished past moment, so use Past Simple: “since she started”.

mistakes.text: She has sprinted at full speed since {the gun went off|she started|she took off}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri dlhom deji, ktorý stále prebieha, je prirodzenejší Present Perfect Continuous: „has been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U dlouhého děje, který pořád probíhá, je přirozenější Present Perfect Continuous: „has been sprinting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a long action that is still going on, Present Perfect Continuous is more natural: “has been sprinting”.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'since she started' (od chvíle, keď vyštartovala), not 'since the gun went off'; both accepted.
